name: dsh-rightbar
description: Right bar: the tab strip, docking panel, expand button, Start page and the `sidebarRightTabs` / `sidebarRight` services every tab type registers into. A GENERATED fork of the shipped bar whose layer disables `ui-sidebar-right` / `ui-sidebar-files`, rendering the kit's recursive `DockSurface` through its own `vendor/dock-tree.js`.
